verdict.rationale: First-party docs and the GitHub README show vLLM installs through standard Python package managers, with uv recommended and pip supported, and give a one-line `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend auto` command. An official Docker Hub image (vllm/vllm-openai) is also offered for deployment. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that installation is actually quick and smooth across hardware backends.
